items.title: Walmart Embraces AI Agents That Shop on Behalf of Customers
items.excerpt: Walmart is setting the rules AI shopping agents must follow to buy on its site on customers' behalf, with spending controls and transaction approvals, while Amazon blocks such agents.

items.title: Meta says Muse has over 10M users, with shopping a top activity
items.excerpt: Meta told investors on its Q3 call that its Muse AI app passed 10M users, with shopping among the top uses, signaling a new AI-mediated discovery surface for brands.

items.title: ChatGPT Ads Is Expanding To New Markets And Exploring New Ad Formats
items.excerpt: ChatGPT Ads expands to 26 new countries after more than 100,000 advertisers used the platform, while OpenAI is still working out what conversational ad formats will look like.

history_match.title: ChatGPT Ads introduces new measurement tools and visual ad formats

items.title: How we built ChatGPT's novel ad stack for user trust and relevance
items.excerpt: OpenAI explains its LLM-powered ad stack that reads conversational intent, keeps ads separate from answers, and serves relevant ads at scale inside ChatGPT.

items.title: How Amazon Ads Plans To Make Programmatic Simple Without Taking Control From Marketers
items.excerpt: Amazon Ads VP Kelly MacLean on the AI-powered Amazon Ads Agent that launches programmatic campaigns in four clicks; beta advertisers saw 18% lower CPMs and 16% lower CPAs.

items.title: Dollar Shave Club markets 'perfectly good' razors as AI push continues
items.excerpt: Dollar Shave Club's new omnichannel campaign used AI for visual gags and helped the brand and agency Humanaut cut production time to about two and a half months.

items.title: Target's holiday push stresses affordability, exclusives and an AI assistant
items.excerpt: Target is rolling out a conversational AI shopping assistant, Ask Target, alongside daily deals to win budget-conscious holiday shoppers.

history_match.title: Why ChatGPT ads won't likely impact holiday sales in a major way this year

items.title: Google turns on PMax image extraction by default from December 4
items.excerpt: From December 4, Google AI will scan landing pages for images to enrich Performance Max creative by default; advertisers and API tools must actively opt out.

items.title: Meta case study credits Nest's AI ads with 20% higher conversion rates
items.excerpt: A Meta case study credits Nest's AI creative tool with 20% higher conversion rates across seven UK brands, though it gives no period or baseline.

history_match.title: Meta says its GEM ads model lifted conversions 18.9% across its apps

items.title: Yelp charges $30 a month for AI agent that answers and qualifies leads
items.excerpt: Yelp's Smart Lead Reply AI agent answers and qualifies Request a Quote leads for movers, roofers and plumbers for $30 a month, plus AI calls to restaurants.

items.title: China Wrote The First GEO Rulebook After A TV Scandal - Western SEOs Should Take Notes
items.excerpt: China's voluntary GEO standards set rules for AI visibility metrics, vendor contracts, pricing and manipulation as brands pay to appear in AI answers.

items.title: AI Search Tools Cited A Made-Up Concept Within A Week, Paper Finds
items.excerpt: Researchers seeded a made-up concept on sites AI search tools cite; four English-web tools repeated it within a week, showing how easily brand claims can be planted in AI answers.
